thread:
Devin: quick pass on the model catalog compact mode — the new dense rows look nice but perf badges are almost unreadable at 6 cols :eyes:
Maria: I noticed that too. at smaller widths badge icons overlap the model name, and color contrast between `badge--good` (blue) and `badge--neutral` (green) is weak
Raj: can we collapse multiple perf badges into a single summary pill? e.g. `Perf: 320ms · 99%` and expand on click
Devin: summary pill is promising but wdyt about discoverability? need keyboard and screen reader support if collapsed
Anne: accessibility nit — hover-only expansion is no-go. must be focusable and use `role="button"` + `aria-expanded` + visible focus ring. also tooltip text needs `aria-describedby`
Sam: small copy tweak: current chip says `Pinned` which reads like a verb. suggest `Pinned to v3.2` or `Pinned (stable)` so folks know which version
Maria: +1 for `Pinned to vX`. also re: filters — the pinned filter should sit above performance filters so it persists when people are scanning for stable builds
Devin: design trade: heatmap-style density view vs list view. heatmap gives immediate perf trend but loses exact numbers. list is verbose but scannable. opinions? :thinking_face:
Raj: heatmap is nice for quick triage, but for compare-table workflows we need precise numbers and copyable values. maybe toggle control to switch modes per user or per workspace
Anne: keyboard flow issue in compare table — when opening the version popover the cell focus disappears. repro steps:
```
1) Tab to compare row
2) Press Enter on version cell
3) Popover opens, focus sent to body, tabbing exits table
```
Expectation: focus should land on first element in popover and return to cell on close
Devin: filed bug #2341 for that behavior, linking perf regression tests and a quick patch suggestion
Sam: UX nit: batch toggle currently sits next to Export button. feels semantically wrong. move it to the Compare settings dropdown top-right? less visual noise that way
Maria: also think we should add subtle row striping in compact mode to help horizontal scanning. tiny 2% contrast diff, nothing aggressive
Raj: implementation note: if we add summary pill we should include the individual badges in the pill's expanded panel for copy/paste; maybe a `Copy metrics` action
Devin: technical constraint: current badge components are heavy (icons + animations). for compact mode we should switch to text-only microbadges to save pixels and render time
Anne: accessibility checklist before rollout: 1) keyboard focus states, 2) aria labels on summary pill, 3) tooltip content accessible, 4) ensure color contrast for badges >= 4.5:1
Devin: proposal for async decision: 1) keep badges visible in list view, 2) add collapsible summary pill in compact view, 3) move batch toggle into Compare settings, 4) implement keyboard/focus fixes. ack/oppose?
Maria: ack :thumbsup:
Raj: ack
Anne: ack, will add tests for focus/aria
Sam: ack, will update copy PR with `Pinned to vX` wording
UX-bot: note created — "compactness vs readability" review by Devin at 1743219876
Devin: thanks everyone, I'll update the figma and link PRs here. if anyone sees strong objections ping me directly
